g.text: Assignment Is Cheap. Everything After It Is the Real System.
The SDK's per-request bucketing costs nothing -- the exposure/conversion pipeline, aggregation,
and stats engine downstream of it are what this design actually has to get right.
is actually served to the user
joins each user's exposure against their later
conversion events, within an attribution window
(experiment, variant, metric, day) -> n, mean, variance
checked once, on a pre-committed schedule
Stops NEW exposures only -- already-served users' exposures
and conversions already logged are untouched.
